predecessors.name: Nazi Germany
predecessors.text: Austria, annexed to Germany in 1938; on 27 April 1945 the Declaration of Independence 'declared Austria's secession from the Third Reich'

ledger.x: 1945: Yugoslav troops occupy parts of Carinthia including Klagenfurt at the end of the Second World War.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1945: the Yugoslavs withdraw from Carinthia, 'soon forced to withdraw by the British forces'.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1945: Renner's provisional government takes office in Vienna and the Second Republic dates from 27 April.
1945: the American zone, Salzburg and Upper Austria south of the Danube.
1945: the British zone, East Tyrol, Carinthia and Styria, from the 9 July 1945 agreement on the zones; the British arrived in Vienna in September.
1945: the French zone, Vorarlberg and North Tyrol, from the 9 July 1945 agreement on the zones.
1945: the Soviet zone, Burgenland, Lower Austria and the Mühlviertel, from the 9 July 1945 agreement on the zones.
1955: the American zone is free of occupation.
1955: the British zone is free of occupation, 'on 25 October the country was free of occupying troops'.
1955: the French zone is free of occupation, 'on 25 October the country was free of occupying troops'.
1955: the Soviet zone and Vienna are free of occupation, 'on 25 October the country was free of occupying troops'.

wars.name: Yugoslav occupation of Carinthia (1945)
wars.outcome: The Yugoslav troops were 'soon forced to withdraw by the British forces'; Carinthia, East Tyrol and Styria formed the British zone and Austria 'successfully held its part of Carinthia against the demands of a resurgent Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia'…

certainty.note: Carinthia: Yugoslav and British troops held lines that no page describes; the zones themselves were agreed on 9 July 1945.

The frontier is the modern Austrian one throughout (no page opened reports a change); the pages opened do not quote the State Treaty's frontier clause, so the sharpness rests on the unchanged outline.
